g.text: On clean scenes with the locker after the pick, the locker sentences make the link
Clean one-pick scenes, locker after the pick, only the bridge token differs (n = 201 / 288 / 205 items on the
9B / 27B / Muse). Lookups switched (%), 95% intervals. The sweep: after the data. Rule, fixed in
advance: the copy at L (or L/2) switches at least half of the changed prompt's switches while the
bridge-word change at L stays at or below 0.25, on 2 of 3 models: holds, 3 of 3. Copy at L:
0.70 / 0.74 / 0.76 of the changed prompt's switches; bridge-word change at L: 0.17 / 0.01 / 0.01 of the items.
